thread.subject: PRIVILEGED & CONFIDENTIAL - Ferrymead v Cobalt: settlement strategy

message.text:
PRIVILEGED AND CONFIDENTIAL - ATTORNEY WORK PRODUCT

Charlotte,

Further to counsel's advice: our assessment is that Ferrymead's exposure on the warranty claim is between 1.8m and 2.4m, and that we should open at 900k and settle at up to 1.6m. Do not share the range with the other side. Ferrymead's board has authorised up to 2m.

James Arden, Harrow & Vance LLP
